summary: APPROVE。静态复核显示 round-6 两个 major finding 均已修复：pending zero-rate 路径具备 deadline/MCS/GE certified wake 与 stale-wake guard；_decide GSL/ISL 及 ISLLink.available_now 的 GE 查询均正确计数。_transmit 的额外计数表示另一真实 GE query，receipt 仅以总查询数>0判定 effective.ge，不构成布尔语义 double-count。旧 F2-RACE/F3/F4/F5/F1-R 与 downlink tail-deadline 修复未见回退。测试执行仍需本地 Agent 验证。

findings.summary: Round-6 finding 1 appears fixed: _decide uses inclusive deadline checks and zero-rate pending packets receive certified deadline/MCS/GE wakes with earliest-wake and stale-timeout guards.

Round-6 finding 2 appears fixed: GSL/ISL decision attribution and ISL pre-gate GE reads increment their query counters; _transmit's separate query accounting does not break receipt effective.ge semantics.

No static regression found in prior D1 fixes: unconditional deadline sweeps, inclusive stop settlement, blocker-correct MCS attribution, constant-rate GSL pre-gates, immediate hard retirement, and downlink non-head deadline waits remain present.
The existing GSL-only outage regression still requires ge_isl_queries == 0, and ISLLink does not query GE while both queues are empty, so the new pre-gate counter is not statically unconditional.
